TextBlock.Text: HALMAHERA. The port never changed hands but the roads to it did, and twelve thousand people have been on emergency rations since the second week of the crisis. The coastal authority has asked France and Spain to land relief, and the arrangement is narrow: this beach, this window, these vehicles. CHARLES DE GAULLE is offshore with a Horizon destroyer and Rafales overhead. The lift is Panthers and Spanish Harriers covering the approach road, with an armoured column going ashore to hold the distribution point rather than to take anything. Nothing here is a target unless it shoots first. The people you are feeding will be living with whoever runs this town next month.
Capitaine de vaisseau A. Mercier, Groupe amphibie
Land the relief and open the distribution point. The port never changed hands; the roads to it did. The people on those roads are why we are here, and they are not a target from any angle.
Relief: Get the relief column to the distribution point Town: Leave the port and its people alone Group: Bring the amphibious group out
Charles de Gaulle, a Horizon destroyer, Rafale M, Panther and Cougar helicopters, a VAB column ashore, Spanish AV-8B and AB-212.
60 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.
Destroying a neutral contact ends the operation in failure. Identify before you shoot.
